title: McpSurvey
description: The survey tool: a read of the blocks the body has seen in a box, by height, with the age of each run.

SurveyInput.description: Read the blocks you have seen inside a box, by height. Give two corners of the box and, optionally, how many height layers to return, from the lowest. Cells you have not seen read as unknown. A large reply is cut short and marked truncated.

SurveyResult.description: The survey as text: layers by height, each a list of run-length rows over a legend of block names, with the age in game minutes of each run. The name unknown marks cells not seen.
